test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
If the mathematical signs are changed as given below, then select the option which represents the correct equation.

× means +

- means x

+ means ÷

÷ means -
solution: __BODMAS RULE__: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebadc30a979bf1a7e953d20901c3e7953c575296c0e0bb4af8a458ec3a64ab2c.png] Symbol + - × ÷ Meaning ÷ × + - **Option (1): 18 × 25 + 5 ÷ 7 × 11 = 27** **After changing the signs:** **⇒ 18 + __25 ÷ 5__ - 7 + 11 = 27** **⇒ __18 + 5__ - 7 __+ 11__ = 27** **⇒ __34 - 7__ = 27** **⇒ 27 = 27** **⇒ LHS = RHS**
